description_en: Queries queues in an Elastic High Performance Computing (E-HPC) cluster
description_zh: 查询指定E-HPC集群的队列列表
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc list-queues --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --queue-names comp --api-version 2024-07-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListQueues

parameters.description_en: The names of the queues that you want to query. You can specify up to eight names.
parameters.description_zh: 待查询队列名称列表，N的取值范围：0～8。
parameters.help_en: The names of the queues that you want to query. You can specify up to eight names
parameters.help_zh: 待查询队列名称列表，N的取值范围：0～8
parameters.name: queue_names
